headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies took down the San Diego Padres 6-4, with Zack Wheeler pitching 7 strong innings and striking out 8. In other action, the Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras hitting a home run. The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, while the San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with the Kansas City Royals' Jonathan India being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. The Boston Red Sox's Trevor Story has also been moved to the 60-day injured list with a sports hernia. Other teams have also seen key players go down with injuries, including the Atlanta Braves' Sean Murphy and the Los Angeles Angels' Travis d'Arnaud.

The Cincinnati Reds made a trade on June 4, sending RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The Atlanta Braves acquired C Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels in a separate trade. The Toronto Blue Jays also made a move, acquiring RHP Simeon Woods Richardson from the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Philly, 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the San Diego Padres 6-4, securing a crucial win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched 7 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the charge at the plate. Contreras hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, contributing to the Orioles' win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1 in a closely contested game. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Update: Jonathan India to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals second baseman Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. This move comes after initially being placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds made a trade on June 4, 2026, sending RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash.
